profile.name: Miguel Ángel Carvajal Ramos
profile.title: Senior Cloud & Platform Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Cloud & Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, automating and operating enterprise cloud platforms across Azure, AWS and GCP. Specialized in Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure Platform Services, API Management, Identity & Access Management, Observability and Site Reliability Engineering. Deep SRE foundation — CI/CD, IaC, incident management, SLO/SLI — applied to both traditional infrastructure and emerging AI/LLMOps reliability.

projects.title: AI Code Review Agent
projects.description: Agentic system built with LangGraph + FastAPI + FAISS that performs automated code reviews on PR diffs. Integrates real tool calling (ruff linter, test coverage), RAG over repo conventions, dynamic context trimming, and structured JSON logging. Deployed via Docker Compose with GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

Cloud Platforms: Azure (AKS, APIM, Event Hubs, Entra ID, Managed Identities, Log Analytics, Application Insights)
AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, SSM, S3)
